games.headline: Alexander-Walker has 27 points as Hawks roll to 107-97 win over Pistons in off game for Cunningham
games.desc: — Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 27 points, Atlanta opened the fourth quarter with an 18-0 run, and the Hawks beat the Detroit Pistons 107-97 on Sunday as Cade Cunningham was held to a season-low five points.

games.headline: Adebayo gets triple-double, Heat (without Giannis) top Thunder (without SGA) for 7th straight win
games.desc: — Bam Adebayo scored 24 points and had a triple-double, Pelle Larsson scored 21 and the shorthanded Miami Heat beat the very shorthanded Oklahoma City Thunder 123-113 on Sunday night to push their winning streak to seven games.

games.headline: Wizards rout the Magic 116-96 to win their 3rd straight following an 8-game skid
games.desc: — Kyshawn George scored 24 points and Anthony Davis added 22 to lead the Washington Wizards to their third straight victory, 116-96 over the Orlando Magic on Sunday night.

games.headline: Jokic's triple-double, Murray's 45 points lead Nuggets to 151-145 overtime win over Bulls
games.desc: — Nikola Jokic had 37 points, 18 rebounds and 11 assists for the 202nd triple double of his career, Jamal Murray scored eight of his season-high 45 points in overtime, and the Denver Nuggets held off the Chicago Bulls 151-145 on Sunday night.

games.headline: Cooper Flagg saves Mavericks with late free throws to hold off Jazz comeback in 116-114 win
games.desc: — Cooper Flagg scored 28 points and made the game-winning free throws with 3.7 seconds left to lift the Dallas Mavericks over the Utah Jazz 116-114 after they squandered an 18-point lead in the fourth quarter on Sunday night.

games.headline: Karl-Anthony Towns has 30 points and 13 rebounds as Knicks beat Pacers 113-106
games.desc: — Karl-Anthony Towns had 30 points and 13 rebounds, Jalen Brunson added 22 points, and the New York Knicks beat the Indiana Pacers 113-106 on Sunday night to extend their winning streak to five games.

games.headline: Brandin Podziemski scores 18 points as Warriors hold of Celtics 88-87 to snap five-game losing skid
games.desc: — Brandin Podziemski had 18 points and seven rebounds and the Golden State Warriors snapped a five-game losing streak by holding off Boston for an 88-87 win Sunday night, sending the Celtics to their first four-game skid in five years.
